description: The enclosed house's west wall, clapboarded, from the corner where the open (lattice-ended) north porch at the sheet's left ends to the corner where the glazed/screened south porch at the sheet's right begins, the gabled bay in the middle included (its face projects 3'-9 1/2"), from grade to the soffit; two windows left of the bay, a paired window in the bay face, one window right of it.

length.note: plan's top string overall over the main block's west side; runs 18'-3" + 2'-0" (to the bay), 16'-0 1/4" (bay face), 2'-0" + 18'-0 1/4". On the elevation the sheet-left corner is where the lattice porch ends (x 4457 px; 20.01 ft from the bay face's outer corner board at x 6458, printed 20'-0 1/4"); the sheet-right corner is hidden behind the glazed porch's end post (the siding stops at x 9980 px, 19.26 ft from the bay's other corner at x 8054 where the plan prints 20'-3", which puts the corner at about x 10079). Scaled 4457 to 9980 px is 55.23 ft.

eave.note: printed SOFFIT 8'-6 1/4" above FLOOR 0'-0" with GRADE -1'-4 1/4" on this elevation: 9.875 ft grade to soffit, the house truth's heights.eave. The level marks are not drawn to scale against the house: on the drawing the soffit line meets the wall at y 3246 px, the siding stops (floor) at y 4161.5 (left) / 4154 (right) and the grade line is at y 4302 (left corner) / 4271 (right), mean 4286.5, so the drawn wall is 10.40 ft grade to soffit at the mean grade. sill_ft is measured from the printed grade placed 9.875 ft below the drawn soffit line (y 4233.5 px).

openings.note: mean of the passes. A: plain frame trim, no projecting sill (the bottom is the frame's bottom line); top where the casings start, on a siding line; plan rough opening 2'-8 1/4" | B: short single-sash kitchen window (north part); the head's top coincides with a siding line. Plan prints a 2'-8 1/4" window 6'-6 1/2" from the north corner.
mean of the passes. A: plan rough opening 2'-8" | B: double-hung; plan prints it 2'-8" wide

mean of the passes. A: a pair of double-hung windows in one trim with a wide centre casing (x 7208 to 7297 px), in the gabled bay's face (projecting 3'-9 1/2"): one opening; plan rough openings 2'-8 1/4" + 6 1/2" + 2'-8 1/4" | B: a pair of double-hung windows in one trim (shared centre casing) on the gable bay's face, 3'-9 1/2" in front of the main wall; plan prints 2'-8 1/4" + 6 1/2" + 2'-8 1/4"
mean of the passes. A: plan rough opening 2'-8 1/4" | B: double-hung, south part; plan prints a 2'-8 1/4" window 6'-9 1/2" from the south corner

porch: Nothing stands in front of the wall itself: the open north porch (its lattice end) is beyond the sheet-left corner and the glazed/screened south porch beyond the sheet-right corner; the latter's end post hides the last 0.6 to 1 ft of the wall.

disagreements.kept: the mean, 5.79 (A: plan rough opening 2'-8" | B: double-hung; plan prints it 2'-8" wide)
